effects.method: audio-to-audio CLAP against bundled CC0 sounds; design proposals also require catalog-name role and CLAP text agreement. Cosine and context contrast are hypotheses, not event truth

limits: Demucs music is all nonvocals, including effects; other is not an isolated effects stem.
Effect count, names and isolated levels need human listening; candidates are not confirmed.
Tempo may be half/double; RMS dynamics and CLAP similarity are not taste or quality ratings.

synced.method: clicks are spikes of 5 kHz-and-up energy about a millisecond wide, 14 dB or more over the local median, in the non-voice sound; share = moments with a click in the window; chance = the same count of random moments
limits: Under speech and music a quiet tick can hide: an unconfirmed count means not heard in the stems, not absent.
Levels are peaks of the non-voice sound against the voice RMS; the timbre needs listening.

transition_click.timbre: a sharp camera-shutter click on the cut frame, often a second click about 65 ms later
transition_click.rule: one on each cutaway transition (cut or flash), starting on the transition frame

word_click.timbre: one soft key strike, short, quiet under the voice
word_click.rule: one on each caption word as it appears, quiet under the voice; ticks closer than 0.18 s are thinned
word_click.evidence: a few clear ticks at caption arrivals in the separated sound; most are masked by speech and music, so the count and level follow listening, not the stems
